Comment the word SYSTEM and I'll send you the free AI Affiliate Blueprint. 🔒

Your first week of faceless AI affiliate marketing, hour by hour. Five hours total.

DAY 1 — 45 minutes. Pick one AI tool you already pay for. Join its affiliate program. Get your link. Don't shop around for a better one, you can switch later.

DAY 2 — 60 minutes. Record one screen demo of that tool doing the thing it's good at. Save it as your template. Same layout every post from here.

DAY 3 to 7 — 30 minutes a day. Post one a day. Change the hook only. Keep the format identical so you can tell what the hook is doing.

The script, five lines:

1. HOOK — "Most people use [tool] wrong."
2. PROBLEM — "They do [slow way] and it takes [time]."
3. DEMO — screen recording, no talking over it.
4. RESULT — "Same job. [Short time]."
5. CTA — "Comment [word] for the full setup."

Fill the brackets, record, post. Thirty seconds of screen is the whole video.

The reason most people never get here: researching feels like progress and costs nothing. Posting badly on day three teaches you more than a month of open tabs.

Comment SYSTEM for the full blueprint.
